_comment: Species scan (docs/SPECIES-SCAN-2026-11-16.md): 30 species x 4 cells x seeds 1-20 x 3 arms = 7,200 runs in 120 batches of 60, one A100-80GB container each. food_sense '@PILOT' is the owner's gain G from pilot 2 (10 if no gain qualifies), supplied at launch with --pilot. '@ALL' expands to every outputs/species/*_genome.json (30). frame_every 15000 keeps frames at steps 0, 15000, 30000 only (frame_every 0 is invalid in gpu_batch.py).
